name: After § 38
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 38a. Stresses the importance of nurturing a constructive political culture and fostering trust-based cooperation among political parties in Ukraine; notes the active participation of Ukrainian parliamentarians in the Jean Monnet Dialogue for Peace and Democracy with the Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine and this year marks 10 years since its launch in October 2016; commends this format as a sustained and constructive instrument of inter-party dialogue that has helped the leadership and all parliamentary factions and groups of the Verkhovna Rada to build consensus on institutional reforms; encourages the Verkhovna Rada to convene a further round to consolidate the reforms required for Ukraine’s accession process;
